Floor price for automated discounts/dynamic offers (MAP compliance)
Required for `preorder` (recommended for `backorder`); max. 1 year in the future; must be visible on landing page
Max. 70 chars; exceptions: movies, books, music; do not use "N/A"/"Generic"; leave empty if truly unbranded
Canonical URL of the landing page (for tracking parameters/variant URLs), max. 2000 chars
Required for EPREL-mandated products in EU/EFTA/UK; replaces the energy efficiency attributes in the EU since 2025-04
Required for apparel with color variants; up to 3 colors separated by `/`
Legally required consumer notices/safety warnings (e.g. EU GPSR, California Prop 65); format: `notice_type:notice_message`
Cost of goods for margin reporting in Merchant Center
Free labels for campaign segmentation; max. 100 chars, up to 1000 unique values per label
Free labels for campaign segmentation; max. 100 chars, up to 1000 unique values per label
Product description, max. 5000 chars; no links/sales info/competitor mentions; formatting allowed

Replaced by `certification` in the EU; use only for CH/NO/UK
Exclude product from destinations; **takes precedence over `included_destination`**
Does not exist in the official specification – was incorrectly listed in the template, removed here
Stop showing the item; < 30 days in the future
Unique seller ID of a marketplace seller; case-sensitive; allowed: ASCII alphanumeric + `_`, `-`, `.`, `~`; must not equal the internal `seller_id`
Minimum order value for free shipping

One single, most specific category from the Google Product Taxonomy; ID preferred; special rules for mobile devices (267), smartwatches (201), tablets (4745), gift cards (53), alcohol, subscription goods
Max. 14 digits per value: UPC (12), EAN (13), JAN (8/13), ISBN (13), ITF-14 (14); GS1 checksum must be valid; submit only if certain it is correct
Daily order cutoff for same-day processing; at offer, country, or shipping-override level
Unique product ID (ideally the SKU), max. 50 chars, stable across updates, valid Unicode only, identical across countries
Default `yes`; set `no` when brand/GTIN/MPN do not exist (e.g. handmade goods)

Main image, max. 2000 chars; formats: JPEG, WebP, PNG, GIF (non-animated), BMP, TIFF; no watermarks/promo text; **min. 500×500 px from 2027-01-31** (warnings since 2026-04-14); AI images: IPTC `DigitalSourceType` metadata must be preserved
Installment payment; `price` must hold the full upfront price; observe country/category restrictions
Marks a bundle of different products
Groups all variants of the same base product; consistent across all variants
Lifestyle image (product in real-world context), 1–2000 chars; formats: GIF, JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF
Landing page, max. 2000 chars, verified domain, http/https
No longer part of the Shopping specification; still used in vehicle feeds
Member prices ONLY via this attribute (not via `price`/`sale_price`); must match the loyalty program settings in Merchant Center; available incl. US, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, JP (points)
Processing time from order to carrier handover
Manufacturer-declared maximum retail price (MRP) for free listings in India; must match landing page/checkout
Processing time from order to carrier handover
Minimum order value at product level
Mobile landing page variant, max. 2000 chars; same requirements as `link`
No longer part of the Shopping specification; still used in vehicle feeds
Max. 70 chars; required if no GTIN; only manufacturer-assigned values
Number of identical single products in a multipack
Pauses the product in Shopping ads without deleting it
Fee for online purchase/reservation with in-store pickup; without threshold the flat rate always applies
Pickup readiness time; required when `pickup_method` is set

US/CA: excl. taxes; all other countries: incl. VAT/GST; must match checkout; not 0 (exceptions: mobile device with contract, physical subscription goods); **since 2025-04-08 no longer used for installment downpayments** (use `installment(downpayment)`)
Bullet highlights: 1–150 chars each; if used, min. 2, max. 100 (recommended 4–6)
Max. 750 chars; your own store categorization; only the first value is used for bidding/reporting in Ads
Links the product to Merchant Center promotion(s)
Regional price/availability overrides (RAAP; generally available since 2025-09, postal-code level in 22 countries)
Return policy at product level; overrides account-level policy; text feed example: header `returns(country:window_days:item_condition:method:shipping_fee)`, value `US:30:NEW:BY_MAIL:8.00 USD`
In addition to `price` (regular price stays in `price`); do not use for loyalty/member prices
Without it, `sale_price` applies permanently; start before end
Item-level shipping costs/times; required if not covered at account level or if deviating
Shipping origin country (if different from target country)
Country exclusion specifically for Shopping ads
Store code, must match the linked Business Profile

Only for eligible `google_product_category` IDs (wireless: 201, 267, 4745, 6030, 6544; physical subscriptions incl. 166, 491, 536, 1253, 2915, 5814, 1868, 2, 499676, 518); for physical subscriptions `price` = 0
Product name, max. 150 chars; no promotional text, no ALL CAPS, must match landing page; include distinguishing attribute (color/size) for variants
Label for transit time tables in Merchant Center
Only together with `unit_pricing_measure`; integers: 1, 10, 100, 2, 4, 8; additional allowed combos: `75cl`, `750ml`, `50kg`, `1000kg`
Required where legally mandated (unit pricing); units: oz, lb, mg, g, kg, floz, pt, qt, gal, ml, cl, l, cbm, in, ft, yd, cm, m, sqft, sqm, ct

Product video (serving since 2026-06-30): 6–240 s, max. 500 MB, ≥720p, aspect ratio 9:16/16:9/1:1; formats: MPG, MP4, WMV, AVI, MOV, FLV, MPEG-1, MPEGPS; direct file link (no player), publicly crawlable
